packet_dag.terminal_condition: The packet is complete when member-safe classroom data exposes an approved-only updates stream, submitted replies stay private pending review, published replies and reward events appear in the student/parent classroom, focused tests pass, and deploy/live smoke is recorded or explicitly blocked.

title: One Time Moderated Comments And Student Updates

reasons: The operator described a private-pending-to-Rabbi-published classroom comment loop.
The operator asked for public updates, scoreboard progress, awards, and positive student-visible feedback.
Existing server code already has hidden member replies, admin review, approved messages, and participation events; this packet connects that data to a member-safe experience.
likely_external_provider_blockers: No external messaging, email, Vimeo, Drive, payment, or access mutation is part of this packet.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this packet, create the access-code/session UX packet for REQ-20260708-027.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time classroom show a clear moderated participation loop: replies are private first, Rabbi/admin can publish them, approved public updates appear for students and parents, and awards/progress are positive-only and privacy-safe.
raw_quotes: any response that one of the kids or parents for that matter makes on a video will show up on their own personal portal and it will just be like pending
the rabbi will publish it live and they'll be able to see whether it was a comment that got published live
a live published comment gets pushed to the other students portal
anytime there's a public update so then the students portal is showing like the updates
if a student does end up getting on the scoreboard so he has some sort of thing that shows up like good job you did it or he could see his Awards and his progress
out_of_scope: No automatic external notification, email send, Telegram send, Vimeo or Drive write, payment mutation, prize, coupon, discount, or access grant.
No display of raw hidden replies, rejected replies, safety-held replies, staff notes, private contact information, internal admin configuration, or unrelated BNA records.
No individual shame ranking or negative points.
affected_surfaces: One Time classroom admin moderation readback

inspection_targets: server.js public response route and admin review route
public/one-time-classroom.html scoreboard, top questions, reply forms
existing One Time moderation and gamification tests
observed: Member replies are inserted hidden with needs_review or held_for_parent_review and visible_to_classroom false.
Admin review can approve a message and optionally create a participation event.
Member-safe thread reads include only visible approved messages.
The classroom already renders top questions and a rewards scoreboard, but it lacks a unified class updates feed and does not surface the approved publication loop clearly.
known_blockers: Per-student personal pending history may require stronger parent/student identity than the current access-code fallback; this packet can still provide response confirmation and approved-only public updates.

expanded_phrases.student portal updates: Render a compact feed of approved class questions, published replies, featured participation, and reward events using only member-safe data.
expanded_phrases.pending to published: Submission responses return a pending-review status; only admin-approved visible messages become member-visible.
expanded_phrases.scoreboard: Show approved participation rows with positive labels and no negative ranking language.
expanded_phrases.awards and progress: Summarize approved points, featured items, published questions, published answers, and review participation as encouragement, not shame.
expanded_phrases.mobile: Feed cards, reply forms, and scoreboard rows stack without overflow at 430px and 390px.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use the existing first-party classroom moderation and participation tables. Do not add or depend on an external CRM or chat runtime.

requirements.statement: Connect the One Time moderated reply loop to member-safe classroom readback.
requirements.expected_result: Submitted replies remain private pending Rabbi/admin review; approved replies become visible to members and can be featured without exposing raw hidden or safety-held text.
acceptance_criteria: Response route still inserts member replies as hidden and returns visible_to_classroom false.
Member-safe readback includes only visible approved messages.
Admin-approved visible and leaderboard-eligible messages can produce approved participation records.

requirements.statement: Add a positive student/parent classroom updates feed from approved comments and rewards.
requirements.expected_result: The classroom shows approved public updates, award/progress notices, and scoreboard achievements with encouraging wording and no private data leakage.
acceptance_criteria: Member-safe classroom payload includes class_updates derived only from approved visible messages and approved classroom participation events.
The classroom UI renders Class Updates with published comments and reward/progress items.
Mobile and desktop layout avoids overflow, overlapping controls, and unreadable dense cards.

criteria: RAW-20260708-006 and the July 8 requirement register exist.
Current-state inspection confirmed private reply, admin review, approved message, and participation event primitives already exist.
External sends/provider writes are explicitly out of scope.
The implementation is limited to One Time classroom data/view and focused tests.
Member-safe output must not include raw hidden or safety-held replies.

requirements: Update cards use readable text labels, not color-only status.
Reply form status is visible beside the form and submit buttons re-enable.

data_requirements.retention: Use existing community message, moderation event, and participation event records.

privacy_invariants: Parent/student/member view sees only member-safe approved content.
Safety-held, rejected, hidden, and unreviewed replies never appear in class_updates.
Classroom participation is positive-only and creates no payment/access entitlement.

instructions: Add a helper that builds update cards from approved visible messages and approved classroom participation events.
Include class_updates in getOneTimeClassroomData for memberSafe reads while keeping raw participation_events hidden.
Avoid adding external sends, notification writes, payment writes, or access writes.
Add a Class Updates section near the scoreboard and top questions.
Render published comments and positive reward/progress items with compact cards.
Keep mobile layout stacked with no horizontal overflow.

Run PQC validation, focused tests, protocol drift watchdog, and browser smoke.
Record evidence in the requirement register, ledger, and changelog.
